reviews.text: I contacted Nelly to look after my almost 6-year-old cat. We had moved a few months prior, and it was the first time he'd been left alone. She was very attentive to my instructions, as he takes daily medication, and she was very helpful in maintaining his routine. She was very kind, very attentive, and I highly recommend her service. I've had other caregivers, and I wholeheartedly recommend her. Gordi and I thank you and will definitely use her services again!
Everything was great! Our dog was in very good company and even sent us a photo to let us know she was okay. Definitely a great choice 😊

Emma's stay at Peluditos Valencia, under Nelly's care, was excellent. It was Emma's first time at a daycare, and I was quite nervous because she's not used to being alone and spends all her time with us.

The experience completely exceeded our expectations. Nelly kept us updated throughout the day and sent us photos of Emma on her sofa, in her bed, and always smiling. This gave us so much peace of mind and allowed me to work without worrying, knowing that she was well cared for and, above all, very pampered.

Emma needs some care and is a very spoiled dog, but Nelly followed all our instructions perfectly. She ate everything, was happy, and when we went to pick her up, she was incredibly affectionate with her. On the second day, she even jumped out of the car, so excited, to go into Peluditos Valencia 🥹❤️.

We loved seeing her feel so comfortable and at home. We will definitely return when we have another long workday or a trip. Highly recommended! 🐶❤️

The best decision I've made is finding Petluditos. My dog ​​Milo LOVES every time we leave him in their care, and my cat Pepper, with her big personality, thoroughly enjoys all the pampering and attention they give her.

They share photos and videos with us. They take such loving care of my furry friends that they don't even realize we're not home, which makes me feel so calm and at ease that I can truly enjoy myself when I'm away. I was terrified of leaving them alone; Pepper was on medication, and it was a big challenge, but Nely has won their trust and affection.

Definitely a sure bet! Thank you for all the love you put into caring for our pets ❤️

I found Nelly through Google while on vacation in Valencia, and since I never leave my dog ​​with just anyone, I was a little worried at first that she might get stressed or not adapt. But everything went great; she sent me photos, and I felt completely at ease. I'm so happy and recommend her 1000%. 🥰🐶 …

Nely inspired confidence in us from the very beginning. Thank you for taking care of Max.
We were on vacation and had a great experience with Petluditos. They looked after our dog while we visited the Oceanogràfic. Fantastic! ❤️ I would definitely use them again.
